summary: Genmab A/S filed a Form 6-K reporting a routine capital increase of 185 shares (nominal DKK 1 each) at DKK 1,334.50 per share, proceeds ~DKK 0.2 million, resulting from employee warrant exercises. The increase is less than 0.001% of share capital, with no preemption rights for existing shareholders. The new shares are ordinary, freely tradable, and will list on Nasdaq Copenhagen. This is an at-the-market employee equity issuance, not a special situation offering. No board recommendation or advisor named. The filing is a standard administrative update with no structural complexity or regulatory implications.
